title: What to buy at 7-Eleven or a convenience store when you want to lose weight
intro: You left the office late, you're hungry, and the only thing open is 7-Eleven or the convenience store downstairs. Don't worry. There are plenty of options that work for a quick meal or snack. The key is to look for protein first, then carbs. The calories below are estimates. Check the label on the pack for more accurate values.

best.name: 2 hard-boiled eggs
best.why: Easy, cheap protein. Keeps you full longer. Good as a snack or added to breakfast.

best.name: Tuna or chicken onigiri
best.why: Controlled portion with some protein. Pair it with hard-boiled eggs for a quick meal.

best.name: Chicken or egg sandwich (triangle pack)
best.why: A quick lunch. Pick one that isn't loaded with mayo.

best.name: Low-fat or unsweetened fresh milk 250ml
best.why: Has protein and calcium. Better than sweet flavoured packet drinks.

best.name: Unsweetened or less sweet yogurt
best.why: A light afternoon snack with some protein.

best.name: 1 banana or cut fruit
best.why: Naturally sweet with fibre. Easy to bring to the office.

careful.name: Hotdog bun with sauce
careful.why: Processed sausage and sweet bread. Okay once in a while, but not very filling for the calories.

careful.name: Cup noodles
careful.why: Mostly flour and oil, little protein. You get hungry again fast.

careful.name: Cream bread or filled bun
careful.why: Sweet and fatty. Easy to eat two without noticing.

careful.name: 1 small packet of chips
careful.why: Salty, crunchy and not filling. If you want some, buy the smallest packet.

careful.name: Large sweet iced drink
careful.why: Liquid calories that don't make you feel full at all.

hacks: Easy formula: 1 protein (egg, milk, yogurt, chicken sandwich) + 1 carb (onigiri, banana, bread). Done.
Read the calorie label on the pack. If one pack has 2 servings, the real calories are double.
Buy the smallest size of your favourite snack. You still get the taste, with calories under control.
Look away from the 'buy 2, cheaper' promo counter. It's cheaper, but you end up eating two.
Don't walk into the shop starving. Keep hard-boiled eggs or fruit in your bag as backup.
drink: Plain water, unsweetened green tea, or unsweetened milk. Avoid flavoured packet drinks and sugary energy drinks.

faq.q: It's late at night and all I have is instant noodles. Can I eat it?
faq.a: Yes. For a more balanced meal, add 2 hard-boiled eggs or a bottle of milk. Use half the seasoning to cut down the salt. Tomorrow, try to prepare a backup snack.

faq.q: What snacks are best to keep at my office desk?
faq.a: Pick ones with protein or fibre, like small packs of roasted nuts, fruit, or yogurt in the office fridge. Portion them out early so you don't finish a big pack in one go.
